title: Surah vs Ayat: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Quran Majeed ki bunyadi tarseem aur hifazat ka farq kya hai? Surah Quran Majeed ka ek pura baab ya chapter hai jise bismillah se shuru kiya jata hai. Jabke Ayat Quran Majeed ke baab ke andar ki ek nishani ya single sentence hai. Surah Quran ka pura chapter hai, jabke Ayat uski ek nishani. Aise hi Islamic comparisons ke liye follow karein.
hook_variants: Quran Majeed ki bunyadi tarseem aur hifazat ka farq kya hai?
Kya aapko Surah aur Ayat mein farq pata hai?
Surah aur Ayat ko ek samajhne ki ghalti mat karein!
